the current deep learning methods for language learning are not sufficiently sample efficient and that the current deep reinforcement learning methods are not sufficiently sample or computation efficient for learning a language with a combinatorially-rich vocabulary.

(1) the current state of the art in deep reinforcement learning is not sample-efficient enough for learning a language with combinatorial properties, and (2) the BabyAI platform can be used for investigating the role of the teacher and the learner in grounded language learning.

(i) the BabyAI platform is a useful tool for studying human-in-the-loop grounded language learning, (ii) current deep learning methods for language grounding are not sufficiently data efficient for this purpose, and (iii) the platform can be used to study the effect of human intervention on grounded language learning.
